title: Machine-learning-guided synthesis identifies a TbIr3 structural phase
summary: Unsupervised clustering and a recommendation workflow guided synthesis and characterization of TbIr3 in a PuNi3-type structure. The authors report two syntheses and structural refinement; the source describes secondary phases, so this is not a phase-pure material claim. The formula was known in other structures; the result is the structure-type assignment.
organization: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Thiruvananthapuram

evidence.tested: The primary source reports the study-specific result summarized here.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and broad deployment are not established by this review. The exact earlier preprint posting day was not established.
evidence.ai_role: Unsupervised structure-type clustering and recommendation nominate TbIr3 for synthesis; diffraction and compositional analysis test the structure assignment.
